name: gitlab
description: Your pending GitLab to-do items (mentions, assignments, review requests, failed pipelines, approvals), read through GitLab's own API with a read-only token you create. Read-only: it never marks a to-do as done.

requires.help: On GitLab select your avatar, Edit profile, Access, Personal access tokens, create a token with only the "read_api" scope, and save it (starts with glpat-) in that file. For a GitLab that is not gitlab.com, also save its address (for example https://gitlab.example.com) in a file named "host" next to it. Steps: extractors/gitlab/README.md. For a work account, your employer's rules decide whether you may do this at all.
